lines.en: Somehow or another, I wind up spending most of the night at the dive bar talking to Osako after getting my ass handed to me at pool. Or billiards if I want to sound pretentious.
lines.zh: 不知怎的,在台球桌上被人打得落花流水之后,我大半个晚上都在那家破酒馆里和 Osako 聊天。或者称之为「桌球」,如果我想显得有格调的话。

lines.en: And what I learn from this is that she has a knack for teaching, which is good considering that she's hanging out with a bunch of teachers right now. And Rika, who is a human that exists.
lines.zh: 而我从中学到的是:她颇有教书的天赋,考虑到她此刻正和一堆老师厮混,这是件好事。还有 Rika——一个确实存在的人类。

lines.en: But between her instructions when it comes to pool and what she's given me at the dojo (When she's not kicking my ass), I can tell that she really loves sharing what she knows with other people.
lines.zh: 但从她教台球时的指导、和她在道场教我的东西(趁她没把我揍扁的时候)来看,我看得出她是真心喜欢把自己的知识分享给别人。

lines.en: I just question why she wants to share that knowledge with me as I've done nothing but cause problems for her during the brief time we've known one another.
lines.zh: 我只是怀疑她为什么想和我分享这些——毕竟在我们相识的这段短暂时光里,我除了给她添麻烦什么都没干。

lines.en: And I have no intention of putting an end to that as it would mean falling in line and acting the way I should.
lines.zh: 而我也无意终止这一切,因为那意味着乖乖排队、活成我应该活成的样子。

lines.en: Don't get me wrong, the idea of complacency sounds lovely. And I want nothing more than to peacefully coexist with all of the misery that inhabits this world.
lines.zh: 别误会,安于现状听起来很美。我不求别的,只想与栖息于这个世界的所有苦难和平共处。

lines.en: But outliers like me can't just fall in line. There are no lines that suit us. And this conversation alone has been very helpful in making me reaffirm that.
lines.zh: 但像我这样的异类没法归队。没有一条队伍适合我们。光是这场对话,就足以让我重新确认这一点。

lines.en: I stick out like a sore thumb. My flaws glow bright beneath the neon.
lines.zh: 我扎眼得要命。我的缺陷在霓虹灯下熠熠生辉。

lines.en: And I spend less time learning pool and more time trying to figure out what the looks I'm getting from my friends mean.
lines.zh: 于是我花在学台球上的时间越来越少,花在琢磨朋友们那些眼神到底是什么意思上的时间越来越多。
